question: How does single-pointed seeking work, like fetching water?
premises: in full being without difference, one fetches water
he seeks the pot, from essence
inference: Exclusive engagement extracts the essence, as water-seeking drops all else.
uncertainties: rasat (from taste/essence) kept open between the two
plain_english: As from non-difference, in full being, one bringing water — abandoning other acts — seeks the pot, from essence.
